description: Predeclared ranking rule over separately reported proxy channels.
missing_optional_policy: renormalize available weights and report coverage
missing_required_policy: do not emit a combined rank score
constraints: Response scores must be calibrated for the selected adapter before fusion.
NetMHCIIpan EL and BA are normalized separately and never averaged at source.
Tolerance contributes only when matched-self and query peptides share an HLA allele.
A query-only self-similarity estimate is displayed but receives no fusion weight.
The score ranks candidates within this computational workflow; it is not a measured immune response probability.
